name: Canva
description: Canva offers a drag-and-drop design suite for creating social media graphics, presentations, and marketing materials with prebuilt templates and a vast element library

tools.name: Access user specific brand templates list
tools.description: Lists brand templates available to users on plans with brand-template access, such as Canva Pro, Canva Teams, or Canva Enterprise. Returns one page of template metadata, including IDs and titles. Follow the response's continuation token to retrieve additional pages. Dataset definitions are available from CANVA_RETRIEVE_BRAND_TEMPLATE_DATASET_DEFINITION.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of brand templates to return (1-100, default 25).

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Lets you search the brand templates available to the user using a search term or terms.

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.about: Filter the list of brand templates based on the brand templates' dataset definitions. Brand templates with dataset definitions are mainly used with the Autofill APIs. This can be one of the following: - `any`: (Default) Brand templates with and without dataset definitions. - `non_empty`: Brand templ

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort the list of brand templates. This can be one of the following: - `relevance`: (Default) Sort results using a relevance algorithm. - `modified_descending`: Sort results by the date last modified in descending order. - `modified_ascending`: Sort results by the date last modified in ascending orde

inputs.name: ownership
inputs.about: Filter the list of brand templates based on the user"s ownership of the brand templates. This can be one of the following: - `any`: (Default) Brand templates owned by and shared with the user. - `owned`: Brand templates owned by the user. - `shared`: Brand templates shared with the user.

inputs.name: continuation
inputs.about: If the success response contains a continuation token, the user has access to more brand templates you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more templates from the list, for example `/v1/brand-templates?continuation={continuation}`. To retrieve all the brand templates a

tools.name: Create Asset Upload Job
tools.description: Uploads an asset file to the user's Canva content library. This endpoint initiates an asynchronous upload job for images or videos. Returns a job ID to track the upload progress. Once complete, the asset can be used in designs, referenced by its asset ID, and managed through other asset endpoints. IMPORTANT: This is an async operation. Use CANVA_FETCH_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB_STATUS to poll the job status until it reaches 'success' or 'failed' status.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Image or video file to upload directly to Canva. Direct upload is the path for large files and for videos larger than the URL-upload limit. No duplicate detection: uploading the same file creates a new asset.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Display name for the asset (maximum 50 characters). The name can be changed later with the Update asset API.

tools.name: Create Canva Design Export Job (Deprecated)
tools.description: Starts a deprecated asynchronous Canva design export job in PNG, JPG, GIF, PDF, PPTX, MP4, HTML bundle, standalone HTML, or CSV format. Export options vary by format; poll the job for completion and download URLs.

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Export format configuration. Set 'type' to one of: 'png', 'jpg', 'pdf', 'gif', 'mp4', 'pptx', 'html_bundle', 'html_standalone', or 'csv'.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: The design ID to export

tools.name: Create canva design with optional asset (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_DESIGNS instead. Creates a new Canva design with specified dimensions or from an asset. This endpoint creates a design using either a preset type (doc, email, presentation, whiteboard), custom dimensions, or by importing an image asset. Returns the design ID, URLs for editing and viewing, owner info, and metadata. The design can be immediately accessed and edited.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Design title (1-255 chars). Appears in Canva UI and design lists.

inputs.name: asset_id
inputs.about: Image asset ID to create design from. Optional if design_type provided. IMPORTANT: Only image assets are supported - video and PDF assets will be rejected by the API with error 'asset_id must belong to an image asset'. Asset IDs are opaque strings with no guaranteed format. To verify an asset is an

inputs.name: design_type

tools.name: Create comment reply in design (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_DESIGNS_DESIGNID_COMMENTS_THREADID_REPLIES instead. This preview API allows replying to comments within a design on Canva, with a limit of 100 replies per comment. Users should note potential unannounced changes, and that preview APIs are not eligible for public integrations.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: Deprecated alias for message_plaintext.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: The design ID. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: The thread ID. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$.

inputs.name: attached_to
inputs.about: The object the comment is attached to.

inputs.name: message_plaintext
inputs.about: The reply comment message. This is the reply comment body shown in the Canva UI. You can also mention users in your message by specifying their User ID and Team ID using the format `[user_id:team_id]`.

tools.name: Create design comment in preview api (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_DESIGNS_DESIGNID_COMMENTS instead. Creates a new comment thread on a Canva design using Canva's deprecated Create comment API. This preview API allows adding text comments to designs for collaboration and feedback. Returns the created comment with ID, author info, and timestamp. Comments can be replied to using the comment reply endpoint.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: Comment text (1-2048 chars). Mention users with [user_id:team_id]. No markdown support. Comments appear unpinned - users must view 'All pages' to see them.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: Design ID to attach comment to

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.about: User ID to assign this comment to. If provided, you must also mention this user in the message text using format [user_id:team_id].

inputs.name: attached_to
inputs.about: Target reference for comment attachment

tools.name: Create Design Import Job
tools.description: Starts an asynchronous import of an external document or design file into Canva designs, including PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PSD, and AI files. Returns a job ID for tracking the import; an import can produce multiple designs.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Document or design file to import. Supported formats: AI, PSD, Affinity (.af, .afdesign, .afphoto, .afpub), Keynote, Numbers, Pages, XLS/XLSX, PPT/PPTX, DOC/DOCX, ODG, ODP, ODS, ODT, and PDF.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title for the imported design (maximum 50 characters). Shows in Canva UI and design lists.

inputs.name: mime_type
inputs.about: Optional MIME type override. It is normalized to a lowercase media type without parameters. If omitted, Canva attempts to detect the file type automatically.

tools.name: Create design merge job
tools.description: Start a preview job that creates or modifies a design using page operations. New designs support page insertion. Existing designs support insert, move, and delete operations. Poll the returned ID with CANVA_GET_DESIGN_MERGE_JOB.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Whether to create a new design or modify an existing design.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title for a new design (required) or optional replacement title for a modified design.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: ID of the target design. Required only when modifying a design.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.about: Ordered page operations. Canva supports one operation by default; apps can request enablement for up to 500 operations.

tools.name: Create Design Resize Job
tools.description: Creates a resized copy of an existing design (Canva Pro/Enterprise only). This endpoint creates a new design with different dimensions from an existing one. The resize operation runs asynchronously and preserves content where possible. Returns a job ID to track progress and retrieve the new design once complete. IMPORTANT: This is an async operation. Use CANVA_RETRIEVE_DESIGN_RESIZE_JOB_STATUS to poll the job status until completion to get the resized design ID and access URLs.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: The source design ID

inputs.name: design_type
inputs.about: Target design type configuration

tools.name: Create URL Asset Upload Job
tools.description: Tool to create an asynchronous Canva asset import job from a public URL. Use when you need to import an asset into Canva directly from a publicly accessible URL without S3 choreography.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL of the file to import (8-2048 characters). Canva rejects non-HTTPS URLs.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Asset name (1-255 characters).

tools.name: Delete asset by id
tools.description: You can delete an asset by specifying its `assetId`. This operation mirrors the behavior in the Canva UI. Deleting an item moves it to the trash. Deleting an asset doesn't remove it from designs that already use it.

inputs.name: assetId
inputs.about: The ID of the asset.

tools.name: Exchange oauth 2 0 access or refresh token
tools.description: The OAuth 2.0 endpoint issues time-limited (4-hour) access tokens of up to 4KB for user authorization via codes or refresh tokens. It requires client ID/secret for authentication.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: Authorization code received after the user authorizes the integration.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.about: Optional space-separated subset of previously granted scopes.

inputs.name: client_id
inputs.about: Integration client ID when credentials are supplied in the request body.

inputs.name: grant_type
inputs.about: OAuth grant type: authorization_code or refresh_token.

inputs.name: redirect_uri
inputs.about: Redirect URI used for the authorization request, when applicable.

inputs.name: client_secret
inputs.about: Integration client secret when credentials are supplied in the request body.

inputs.name: code_verifier
inputs.about: PKCE code verifier used for an authorization-code exchange.

inputs.name: refresh_token
inputs.about: Refresh token to exchange when grant_type is refresh_token.

tools.name: Fetch asset upload job status
tools.description: Retrieves the status of a direct asset file upload job. Poll until it succeeds or fails; a successful job can return asset ID and metadata, while a failed job can return error details.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.about: The asset upload job ID returned by CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB or CANVA_POST_ASSET_UPLOADS. This is the 'id' field from the job object in the response. IMPORTANT: This tool does NOT work for job IDs from CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB (URL import jobs use a different endpoint - use CANVA_GET_U

tools.name: Fetch canva connect signing public keys
tools.description: The API for verifying Canva webhooks, 'connect/keys,' is in preview, meaning unstable, not for public integrations, and provides a rotating JWK for signature verification to prevent replay attacks. Cache keys for efficiency.

tools.name: Fetch current user details
tools.description: Returns the User ID and Team ID associated with the provided access token. Use CANVA_RETRIEVE_USER_PROFILE_DATA to retrieve the user's display name.

tools.name: Fetch design metadata and access information
tools.description: Gets the metadata for a design. This includes owner information, URLs for editing and viewing, and thumbnail information.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design ID (1-50 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens), for example DAFVztcvd9z.

tools.name: Get design comment thread replies
tools.description: Retrieves a page of replies for a comment or suggestion thread on a design. Returns up to limit replies (default 50, maximum 100); follow the continuation token to retrieve the rest. This is a preview API. Public integrations that use it cannot pass Canva's review process.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of replies to return. Default is 50. Minimum value: 1, Maximum value: 100.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design ID.

inputs.name: threadId
inputs.about: The ID of the thread.

inputs.name: continuation
inputs.about: Token for pagination to retrieve more items from the list. If the response contains a continuation token, use it to retrieve more replies.

tools.name: Get specific design comment reply
tools.description: Retrieves a specific reply to a comment or suggestion thread on a design. Use when you need to view details of a particular reply. This is a preview API. Public integrations that use it cannot pass Canva's review process.

inputs.name: replyId
inputs.about: The reply identifier. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design identifier.

inputs.name: threadId
inputs.about: The comment thread identifier. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$.

tools.name: Get design dataset
tools.description: Get a design's autofill dataset definition and accepted field types.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The Canva design ID.

tools.name: Get design export job result
tools.description: Retrieves a design export job's status and result. Poll until the job succeeds or fails; successful jobs can provide download URLs for exported pages, which expire after 24 hours.

inputs.name: exportId
inputs.about: The export job ID.

tools.name: Get design generation job
tools.description: Retrieve a design generation job created by the same user and integration. Call repeatedly until the returned status reaches `success` or `failed`. The user must have Canva's `design_generation` capability. Jobs expire 24 hours after creation, and only the creating user, integration, and team can retrieve them.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: Public design-generation job ID returned when the job was created.

tools.name: Get design merge job
tools.description: Return a design merge job's current status and result. Call this action repeatedly until the returned status is `success` or `failed`.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.about: The design merge job ID.

tools.name: Get designs designid comments threadid
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a comment or suggestion thread on a design. Use when you need to get details about a specific thread including content, author, timestamps, and status. This is a preview API. Public integrations that use it cannot pass Canva's review process.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design identifier.

inputs.name: threadId
inputs.about: The thread identifier.

tools.name: Get design export formats
tools.description: Lists available file formats for exporting a design. Use this to check which export formats (PDF, JPG, PNG, SVG, PPTX, GIF, MP4, HTML bundle, standalone HTML, and CSV) are supported for a specific design.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design ID.

tools.name: Get URL asset upload job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and result of a URL-based asset upload job. Use this after creating a URL asset upload job to check progress and retrieve the uploaded asset ID when successful.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.about: The asset upload job identifier.

tools.name: Get URL import job status
tools.description: Retrieves the status and result of a URL import job. Repeatedly check until it succeeds or fails; a successful result contains imported designs and their metadata, while a failed job returns an error.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.about: The URL import job ID.

tools.name: Get user capabilities
tools.description: Lists the API capabilities for the user account associated with the provided access token. Use when you need to check what features are available based on the user's Canva plan.

tools.name: Initiate canva design autofill job
tools.description: Creates an asynchronous autofill job from a brand template or existing design, or updates an existing design in place. Canva Enterprise users are eligible; paid-plan users can use a limited development trial. Poll the returned job ID with CANVA_RETRIEVE_DESIGN_AUTOFILL_JOB_STATUS.

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: Data object containing the data fields and values to autofill. Keys are field names from the brand template. Values can be text, image, video, chart, or sheet data fields.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Autofill source and behavior. Defaults to create_from_brand_template.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Title to use for the autofilled design. Must be less than 256 characters. If no design title is provided, the autofilled design will have the same title as the brand template.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: Source or target design ID for create_from_design or update_design.

inputs.name: brand_template_id
inputs.about: ID of the input brand template.

tools.name: List design pages with pagination
tools.description: Preview API for Canva: subject to unannounced changes and not for public integrations. Lists metadata for design pages with optional `offset` and `limit`; not applicable to all design types.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of pages to return, starting at the page index specified using the `offset` parameter. Default is `50` pages. Minimum: 1, Maximum: 200.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.about: The page index to start the range of pages to return. Default is `1`. Pages are indexed using one-based numbering, so the first page in a design has the index value `1`. Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design ID.

tools.name: List folder items by type with sorting
tools.description: Lists folder items, including folders, designs, image assets, and brand templates. Brand templates are returned only when explicitly requested in `item_types` and the user's plan supports them. Video assets are currently not returned.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of folder items to return (1-100, default 50).

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort the list of folder items. This can be one of the following: - `created_ascending`: Sort results by creation date, in ascending order. - `created_descending`: Sort results by creation date, in descending order. - `modified_ascending`: Sort results by the last modified date, in ascending order. -

inputs.name: folderId
inputs.about: The folder ID. Must be a non-empty string. Use 'root' to list items in the root folder.

inputs.name: item_types
inputs.about: Filter the folder items to only return specified types. The available types are: `brand_template`, `design`, `folder`, and `image`. To filter for more than one item type, provide a comma- delimited list.

inputs.name: pin_status
inputs.about: Filter by pinned status: 'any' returns all items and 'pinned' returns only pinned items.

inputs.name: continuation
inputs.about: If the success response contains a continuation token, the folder contains more items you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more items from the list, for example `/v1/folders/{folderId}/items?continuation={continuation}`. To retrieve all the items in a folder, you mi

tools.name: List User Designs
tools.description: Lists one page of Canva user design metadata, with search, ownership filtering for owned and shared designs, and sorting options. Use the response continuation token to retrieve further pages.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of designs to return. Minimum 1, maximum 100, default 25.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Lets you search the user"s designs, and designs shared with the user, using a search term or terms.

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Sort the list of designs. This can be one of the following: - `relevance`: (Default) Sort results using a relevance algorithm. - `modified_descending`: Sort results by the date last modified in descending order. - `modified_ascending`: Sort results by the date last modified in ascending order. - `ti

inputs.name: ownership
inputs.about: Filter the list of designs based on the user"s ownership of the designs. This can be one of the following: - `owned`: Designs owned by the user. - `shared`: Designs shared with the user. - `any`: Designs owned by and shared with the user.

inputs.name: continuation
inputs.about: If the success response contains a continuation token, the list contains more designs you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more designs from the list, for example `/v1/designs?continuation={continuation}`. To retrieve all of a user"s designs, you might need to make

tools.name: Move item to specified folder
tools.description: Transfers an item to a different folder by specifying both the destination folder's ID and the item's ID. If the item is in various folders, an error occurs; manual relocation via Canva UI is required.

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the item you want to move. Item IDs are alphanumeric strings, 1-50 characters. Design IDs have format like 'DAFVztcvd9z', folder IDs like 'FAF2lZtloor', and asset IDs like 'Msd59349ff'. Obtain item IDs from the List designs, List folder items, or other Canva API endpoints. Note: Video asse

inputs.name: to_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the folder you want to move the item to (the destination folder). Folder IDs are alphanumeric strings (e.g., 'FAF2lZtloor'), 1-50 characters. Use the special ID 'root' to move the item to the top level of a Canva user's projects, or 'uploads' for the Uploads folder. Obtain folder IDs from

tools.name: Create new Canva design
tools.description: Creates a Canva design from a preset type, custom dimensions, an image asset, an existing design, or a brand template; an image asset can also be inserted with a preset or custom type. Copying designs and using brand templates are preview features; returns design ID, edit/view URLs, and metadata.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Creation mode. Omit or use 'type_and_asset' for a preset/custom design or asset; use 'design' to copy a design; use 'brand_template' to copy a brand template. The copy modes are Canva preview features.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Design name (1-255 characters). Appears in Canva UI and design lists.

inputs.name: asset_id
inputs.about: Image asset ID to insert into the design. Currently supports image assets only. Must be a valid asset ID from a previously uploaded asset.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: ID of the existing Canva design to copy when type is 'design'

inputs.name: design_type
inputs.about: Design type configuration. Can be a preset name string ('doc', 'email', 'whiteboard', 'presentation') which will be auto-converted to the required format, or a nested object for preset (e.g., {'type': 'preset', 'name': 'presentation'}) or custom dimensions (e.g., {'type': 'custom', 'width': 1080, 'h

inputs.name: page_numbers
inputs.about: One-based page numbers to copy from a design or brand template. If omitted, all pages are copied.

inputs.name: brand_template_id
inputs.about: ID of the Canva brand template to copy when type is 'brand_template'

tools.name: Post designs designid comments
tools.description: Creates a comment thread on a Canva design. Use when you need to add feedback or collaboration comments to a specific design. Rate limited to 100 requests per minute per user. This is a preview API. Public integrations that use it cannot pass Canva's review process.

inputs.name: designId
inputs.about: The design ID where the comment will be created. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.about: Optional user ID for assignment. If specified, the assignee must be mentioned in the message using [user_id:team_id] format.

inputs.name: message_plaintext
inputs.about: The comment message in plaintext shown in Canva UI. Must be between 1 and 2048 characters. User mentions use format [user_id:team_id].

tools.name: Create reply to comment thread
tools.description: Tool to create a reply to a comment or suggestion thread on a Canva design. Use when you need to respond to existing comments or suggestions. Maximum 100 replies per thread allowed. This is a preview API. Public integrations that use it cannot pass Canva's review process.

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: The design identifier. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$

inputs.name: thread_id
inputs.about: The identifier of the thread to reply to. Must match pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$

inputs.name: message_plaintext
inputs.about: The reply text content. Must be between 1 and 2048 characters. Users can be mentioned using the format [user_id:team_id].

tools.name: Start design export job
tools.description: Starts a new asynchronous job to export a Canva design file. Use when exporting designs to various formats (PDF, JPG, PNG, GIF, PPTX, MP4, CSV, and HTML). Returns a job ID that can be used to poll for completion status and download URLs. IMPORTANT: Format compatibility varies by design type. Before exporting, use the CANVA_GET_DESIGNS_DESIGNID_EXPORT_FORMATS action to check which formats are supported for the specific design. Attempting to export in an unsupported format will result in a 400 error (e.g., 'png export not supported for this design type').

inputs.name: format
inputs.about: Export format configuration. Specify the format type and format-specific options. Exported files remain available for download for 24 hours. IMPORTANT: Not all formats are supported for all design types. Use GET /v1/designs/{designId}/export-formats to check which formats are supported for a specifi

inputs.name: design_id
inputs.about: The identifier of the design to export (e.g., 'DAGz4y3LDFI')

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Tool to create a folder in Canva. Use when you need to organize designs, assets, or create nested folder structures in a user's projects or uploads folder.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The display name for the new folder. Must be 1-255 characters. Duplicate names are allowed.

inputs.name: parent_folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the destination location. Use 'root' for top-level projects, 'uploads' for the uploads folder, or a specific folder ID to nest within another folder. Must be 1-50 characters.

tools.name: Create URL Import Job
tools.description: Tool to start an asynchronous job to import an external file from a URL as a new design in Canva. Use when you need to import a design from a publicly accessible URL. This is an async operation; poll the job status using the job ID until it reaches 'success' or 'failed'.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL of the file to import. This URL must be accessible from the internet and be publicly available (1-2048 characters).

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Name assigned to the imported design (1-255 characters).

inputs.name: mime_type
inputs.about: Supported design-import MIME type (for example, 'application/pdf' or 'application/vnd.apple.keynote'). It is normalized to a lowercase media type without parameters. Canva attempts automatic detection if omitted or empty (1-100 characters when provided).

tools.name: Remove folder and move contents to trash
tools.description: Deletes a folder by moving the user's content to Trash and reassigning other users' content to their top-level projects.

inputs.name: folderId
inputs.about: The folder ID.

tools.name: Retrieve app public key set
tools.description: Returns the Json Web Key Set (public keys) of an app. These keys are used to verify JWTs sent to app backends.

inputs.name: appId
inputs.about: The app ID. Must be 1-50 alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens.

tools.name: Retrieve asset metadata by id
tools.description: You can retrieve the metadata of an asset by specifying its `assetId`.

inputs.name: assetId
inputs.about: The ID of the asset.

tools.name: Retrieve brand template dataset definition
tools.description: Gets the dataset definition for a brand template. Available to users on plans with brand-template access, such as Canva Pro, Canva Teams, or Canva Enterprise. Data fields can contain images, text, and charts; chart data is a preview feature.

inputs.name: brandTemplateId
inputs.about: The brand template ID.

tools.name: Retrieve brand template metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a brand template. Available to users on plans with brand-template access, such as Canva Pro, Canva Teams, or Canva Enterprise.

inputs.name: brandTemplateId
inputs.about: The brand template ID.

tools.name: Retrieve design autofill job status
tools.description: Retrieves a design autofill job result. Canva Enterprise users are eligible, while paid-plan users can use a limited development trial. Poll until the status is `success` or `failed`.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.about: The design autofill job ID.

tools.name: Retrieve design import job status
tools.description: Retrieves a design import job's status and result. Poll until success or failure; a successful import returns a list of imported designs and their metadata.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.about: The design import job ID.

tools.name: Retrieve Design Resize Job Status
tools.description: Retrieves the status and results of a design resize job. Polls for design resize job completion status. Use this after CANVA_CREATE_DESIGN_RESIZE_JOB to check the resize progress. Keep polling until status is 'success' or 'failed'. Successful jobs include the new design ID and temporary access URLs.

inputs.name: job_id
inputs.about: The resize job ID returned from create resize job endpoint

tools.name: Retrieve folder details by id
tools.description: Gets the name and other details of a folder using a folder's `folderID`.

inputs.name: folderId
inputs.about: The folder ID.

tools.name: Retrieveuserprofiledata
tools.description: Currently, this returns the display name of the user account associated with the provided access token. More user information is expected to be included in the future.

tools.name: Revoke oauth tokens
tools.description: Revoke an access token or refresh token. Revoking a refresh token also revokes its lineage and user consent, requiring re-authentication. Authenticate using either basic access with Base64-encoded credentials or body parameters with client ID and secret.

inputs.name: token
inputs.about: The token to revoke.

inputs.name: client_id
inputs.about: Your integration"s unique ID, for authenticating the request. NOTE: We recommend that you use basic access authentication instead of specifying `client_id` and `client_secret` as body parameters.

inputs.name: client_secret
inputs.about: Your integration"s client secret, for authenticating the request. Begins with `cnvca`. NOTE: We recommend that you use basic access authentication instead of specifying `client_id` and `client_secret` as body parameters.

tools.name: Update asset s name and tags by id
tools.description: You can update the name and tags of an asset by specifying its `assetId`. Updating the tags replaces all existing tags of the asset.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the asset. This is shown in the Canva UI. When this field is undefined or empty, nothing is updated. Maximum length 50 characters.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: The replacement tags for the asset. When this field is undefined, nothing is updated. Maximum length 50 tags. Each tag has a maximum length of 50 characters.

inputs.name: assetId
inputs.about: The ID of the asset.

tools.name: Update folder details by id
tools.description: Updates a folder's details using its `folderID`. Currently, you can only update a folder's name.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The folder name, as shown in the Canva UI (1-255 characters).

inputs.name: folderId
inputs.about: The folder ID.

tools.name: Validate oauth token properties
tools.description: Check an access token's validity and properties via introspection, requiring authentication. Use Basic access (Base64 encoded `client_id:client_secret`) or body parameters for credentialing.

inputs.name: token
inputs.about: The token to introspect.

inputs.name: client_id
inputs.about: Your integration"s unique ID, for authenticating the request. NOTE: We recommend that you use basic access authentication instead of specifying `client_id` and `client_secret` as body parameters.

inputs.name: client_secret
inputs.about: Your integration"s client secret, for authenticating the request. Begins with `cnvca`. NOTE: We recommend that you use basic access authentication instead of specifying `client_id` and `client_secret` as body parameters.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Returns the connected Canva account's user and team IDs and, when available, its profile display name. The top-level display name falls back to the user ID if the profile name is unavailable.
